newsitem.title: DENMARK: FLS sells plastic activities to Sweden.
newsitem.headline: FLS sells plastic activities to Sweden.

text.p: Danish engineering and cement group FLS Industries said on Wednesday it had sold the Scandinavian activities of its Nyborg Plast International A/S unit to Sweden's Trioplast Industrier AB for an undisclosed sum.

It said the deal embraced Denmark-based Nyborg Plast A/S, Nyborg Plast Norway and activities in Sweden, with a total annual turnover of some 400 million Danish crowns, own capital of around 68 million crowns and 360 staff.
Nyborg Plast International, which will remain part of the FLS group, is to be renamed FLS Plast A/S and will become a holding company for French subsidiaries Silvallic, SMS and Promosac, FLS said.
It said the deal, which it hoped would be finalised by end-June, was subject to the usual satisfactory due diligence requirements.
"The sale will have a positive effect on FLS Industries' 1997 result," it said in a statement. --Chris Follett, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33969652
